name: huggingface-mcp
description: Hugging Face (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_huggingface_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN
platform_mcp_huggingface_token.description: Hugging Face user access token (https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens); a write (or fine-grained repo write) token for create/update.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /api/whoami-v2: the token's user, organisations and token role/scopes.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}?search&limit: Hub repositories (collection picks the repo type, default models). Only the first page is returned: the Hub paginates with a Link response header, which the runtime does not follow, so narrow with query.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}: repo info (item_id is the full repo id such as google/gemma-2b; files in raw.siblings, card metadata in raw.cardData).

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /api/repos/create {type, name, organization, private, sdk, license}: creates an empty repo. title is the repo name; collection models|datasets|spaces sets the type (default model); fields may carry organization, private (boolean), sdk (gradio|docker|static, required for spaces) and license. Files are pushed with the commit API (not mapped).

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: PUT /api/{models|datasets|spaces}/{namespace}/{repo}/settings: repo settings from fields (private, visibility private|public|protected, gated false|auto|manual, discussionsDisabled, gatedNotificationsEmail). title/content are not repo settings and are not sent.
